name: helioterm
description: Semantic terminal compression, optional Headroom MCP interoperability, intelligent Desktop Luna routing, and background command supervision without model polling.

interface.shortDescription: Compressed terminal work without model polling.
interface.longDescription: HelioTerm batches bounded terminal observations, supervises long commands, and persists background jobs while Codex continues other work. Complete facts use deterministic compression; an optional internal Headroom MCP backend can compress generic retained evidence without adding an owner-visible tool boundary; failures, real patches, and diverse truncated evidence can route to one reusable Desktop-native Luna task whose bounded note is validated by code and archived after the burst.
defaultPrompt: Use $helioterm for bounded tests, checks, Git, search, source/config inspection, dependency, version, benchmark, and process observations; batch up to four compatible operations.
